scale_model: HOMOGRAPHY ground-plane calibration from homography.npy (bottom-centre reference)
CALIBRATION_PROVENANCE: STANDARD IRC ROAD MEASUREMENTS - NOT SITE-VERIFIED. The exact location of this camera is unknown, so no distance in this scene was physically measured or checked against a map. The ground-plane scale is anchored on IRC lane-marking pitch (3.0 m dash + 4.5 m gap = 7.5 m) and IRC urban lane width 3.5 m, applied to lane markings detected in frame 154. Every speed inherits any error in those assumptions: if the real pitch or lane width differs, all speeds scale proportionally. Site verification (a measured distance, or the road identified on a map) is required before these numbers can be called measurements.

irc_assumptions.standard: IRC 35 (Code of Practice for Road Markings) / IRC 86 (urban lane width)
irc_assumptions.dash_pitch_note: IRC 3.0 m dash + 4.5 m gap. Pitch is the scale anchor and validated to 7.52 m mean (sd 0.22) across 5 measured intervals.
irc_assumptions.solved_dash_note: Dash:gap split was SOLVED from the image, not assumed: forcing the IRC 3.0 m dash gave systematically inconsistent geometry. Measured dash ~3.85 m with ~3.65 m gap. Pitch (the scale-setting quantity) still matches IRC.

min_ref_y_note: Speed reported only where the box bottom-centre is at row >= 268.0, i.e. inside the region the homography was fitted over (lane dashes spanned y~268-503 in frame 154). Vehicles further away are still detected and tracked, but carry no speed rather than an extrapolated one.
WARNING: Speeds derived from IRC-standard road geometry, NOT from a site-verified measurement. Absolute values are only as correct as those standards are for this specific road. Not valid for enforcement.
